source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: Ugh, I’ve spent all morning troubleshooting my sprinkler system, it keeps dousing my potted mint every other hour and I think the timer’s busted, plus my cat knocked over my favorite ceramic planter yesterday so I’ve been sweeping shards off the porch nonstop. I was also thinking I should pick up some more strawberry jam this weekend since I finished the last jar at breakfast. Oh right, I need a video surveillance camera that has motion detection, 3mp resolution, for a reasonable price.
